::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
ST's India centre in Noida is one of its major design hubs, with significant work on STM32 microcontroller family and MEMS sensor design.
:::

## What does this firm design?

STM32 microcontrollers, MEMS inertial sensors and microphones, power management ICs, and SiC power devices.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** MCUs, analog, MEMS and power; some AI accelerator work.
- **Strategic depth 4/5:** Greater Noida is ST's largest design centre outside Europe; has produced designed-in-India chips.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** Current postings cover RTL design leadership, analog design, AI accelerator digital design and validation.
- **India scale 3/5:** No 2024–26 India figure found; 1,500 in 2006 on a 5,000-capacity campus; 2,500 unverified.
